name: Granularity Calculation Formula
definition: A method to calculate the optimal screen cell size (g) for parallel volume rendering by approximating the 3D volume projection as an n x n square and dividing it into g x g pixel cells to achieve a target total number of screen cells (C).
summary: The Granularity Calculation Formula determines optimal screen cell size for parallel volume rendering by dynamically adapting to the camera view, unlike static partitioning.
